lines.text: Bel and Nebo crouch, their idols weigh down beasts and cattle, and the gods themselves go into captivity.
The LORD tells the house of Jacob He has carried them since birth and will bear them up when they turn gray.
People hire a goldsmith to make a god, carry it on their shoulders, and set it in place, where it stands still.

lines.text: The LORD says there is no other God, and He summons a lion from the east for His purpose.
The LORD is bringing His righteousness near, His salvation will not be delayed, and He will grant salvation to Zion.
